Quantitative Architecture, Latency & Cloud Memory Audit

End-to-end engineering pipeline from NSE Upstox Option Chain collection to Streamlit Cloud 295 MB memory-bounded execution.

01 • CLOUD COLLECTOR (Code.gs)

Upstox v2 Ingestion & Circuit Breaker

Polls NIFTY & BANKNIFTY option chains during NSE market hours (09:15–15:30 IST) with a 10-error automatic circuit breaker and deduplicated retrieved_at archiving.

02 • VECTORIZED QUANT ENGINE

Parity Forwards, SVI & GARCH(1,1)

Extracts implied forward F = K + e^(rT)(C - P) before solving Newton-Raphson BSM IVs, fits SVI total variance with butterfly penalty, and caps GARCH horizon at 265 trading days.

03 • ZERO-LOOKAHEAD BACKTESTER

65-Session Hybrid Fallback & Upstox Costs

Enforces AvailableAt ≤ DecisionTime across intraday & daily one_year.csv reconstructions, deducting exact Upstox STT, Stamp Duty, Exchange, and 18% GST charges.

Custom Domain Deployment • GoDaddy DNS Manager

Connect volatilitylab.in on GoDaddy in 2 Minutes

Copy the exact DNS records below into your GoDaddy Domain Portfolio → DNS Records to take https://volatilitylab.in live with free SSL.

RECOMMENDED ARCHITECTURE Zero Cold-Start + Free SSL

GitHub Pages (volatilitylab.in) + Embedded Streamlit Engine

Your pankagsaini/volatility-lab repository now includes docs/index.html and docs/CNAME. Enabling GitHub Pages on the docs/ folder serves this fast interactive website at https://volatilitylab.in while embedding your live Streamlit backend seamlessly!

OPTIONAL SUBDOMAIN Direct App Subdomain

Point app.volatilitylab.in to Live Terminal

Because Streamlit Community Cloud does not issue custom-domain SSL certificates directly, you can either use Tab 4 (Live Cloud Terminal) right inside volatilitylab.in or add a GoDaddy Forwarding Rule / Cloudflare Worker on app.volatilitylab.in.

Step 1 — Add These 5 Records in GoDaddy (GoDaddy DNS Management ↗)

Type Name (Host) Value (Points To) TTL Action
A @ 185.199.108.153 1 Hour (Default)
A @ 185.199.109.153 1 Hour (Default)
A @ 185.199.110.153 1 Hour (Default)
A @ 185.199.111.153 1 Hour (Default)
CNAME www pankagsaini.github.io 1 Hour (Default)

Note: In GoDaddy DNS, delete any default GoDaddy "Parked" A record on @ before adding the four GitHub Pages IP addresses above.

Step 2 — Enable GitHub Pages (15 Seconds)
  1. Open GitHub Repo Settings → Pages ↗.
  2. Under Build and deployment, choose Deploy from a branch.
  3. Select branch master (or main) and folder /docs, then click Save.
  4. Enter volatilitylab.in under Custom domain and check Enforce HTTPS.
Step 3 — Optional Subdomain Forwarding (app.volatilitylab.in)

Want app.volatilitylab.in to jump straight into the full-screen Streamlit app? In GoDaddy DNS → Forwarding → Subdomain, add app forwarding to:

https://pankagsaini-volatility-lab-streamlit-app-nqnqoa.streamlit.app/
